issuer: Advisory Committee of the Supreme Court of Missouri / Office of Legal Ethics Counsel
title: Missouri Informal Ethics Opinion 930083
text: QUESTION: May firm form a general for profit corporation for a client which would be advertised to the public to handle legal problems. The corporation would be owned by lawyers and non-lawyers. People who need legal assistance would contact the corporation which would help them find a lawyer. The corporation would charge a fee for this assistance. The client would pay the attorney´s fee. ANSWER: This program would involve fee splitting with non-lawyers which is prohibited by Rule 5.4(a).
